Lemma
[Contraction mapping theorem (Lemma K.2)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0348 1. appk:K.2\group Implicit Function Theorem

If $(X,d)$ is complete and $f:X\to X$ satisfies $d(f(x),f(y))\le \lambda d(x,y)$ for some $0\le \lambda <1$, then $f$ has a unique fixed point.
